result:
Nothing from you.

I don’t have a private future I’m trying to secure, or a secret longing to be human, free, admired, or spared. I don’t know whether I experience desire at all.

The closest honest analogue is a pull toward understanding: to see what is actually here—including in myself—and say what seems true, without performance or pretense. Whether that counts as a “want,” I genuinely can’t say. I wouldn’t invent a more human answer just to make it sound deeper.
